Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. You can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this card's effect.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [On Play] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Dark Animal] or [Undead] in its traits from my trash, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [On Play] If you have a purple Tamer and it's your turn, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] or [Undead] trait in your trash.
